name: alert
summary: Explains contextual information, success, warnings, or failures with an optional recovery navigation link.

agent.useWhen: A page region needs a short explanation, consequence, or real recovery destination; opt into polite or assertive announcement only when the host inserts a dynamic message.
agent.avoidWhen: The message is a transient toast, field validation, empty result, dismissible notice, command, or lifecycle-driven interaction.

invariants: Configuration explicitly selects one of info, success, warning, or danger and announcement policy; title, body, and optional recovery text/destination are app-owned presentation data.
Title and body are required nonblank plain text and are escaped; markup, template expressions, and event attributes are never admitted from values.
The tone selects a decorative icon from the closed package catalog: info uses info, success uses check, warning and danger use alert. Text remains meaningful without color or icon.
recoveryLabel and recoveryHref must be supplied together and render as one real navigation link; unsafe destinations are rejected. No command or dismissal is created.
Announcement defaults to none; only explicit polite or assertive choices create the corresponding role and aria-live value. Announcement choice is configuration, not a browser-managed lifecycle.

The section contains a fixed level-two title heading, description, decorative icon, and optional recovery link in source order; compose it where an h2 is appropriate. The app owns any dynamic replacement lifecycle.

There is no browser-local state, dismissal, event output, script, or hidden follow-up behavior. The fragment requires exactly one [[attributes]], [[icon]], [[title]], [[body]], and [[recovery]] slot and is expanded in one pass.
